question: What Settings localization contract should OpenClaw support for schema/uiHint-derived config labels, and how should the two open partial PRs be sequenced?
rationale: Fixed Settings UI chrome can use the existing generated locale pipeline, but schema-derived labels cross config metadata and locale-key boundaries while two open PRs already overlap the same Settings area.

options.title: Define one Settings i18n contract
options.body: Agree on a key/fallback design for Settings chrome, Quick Settings, section metadata, and schema labels, then rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

options.title: Land chrome slices first
options.body: Review and land low-risk toolbar or Quick Settings localization while keeping schema-derived labels tracked as explicit follow-up work.

options.title: Defer schema labels
options.body: Limit near-term localization to fixed Settings UI chrome and leave config schema labels English until maintainers want a broader metadata translation API.

recommendation.title: Define one Settings i18n contract
recommendation.body: Agree on a key/fallback design for Settings chrome, Quick Settings, section metadata, and schema labels, then rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest recent generated-locale and current Settings-file routing signal; config-schema label owners can review the schema-specific contract once the i18n shape is chosen.
